lines.x: Your room is quite neat, Doctor. Not bad.

Water is the core ingredient of life. I've talked to Miss Closure about improving Rhodes Island's water purification system. I hope that my research can be of help… If everything goes well, then I don't have to worry about the water being dirty anymore.

This is Leaf, a Bionic Seadragon that I produced from a prototype design passed across my family. In addition to auxiliary combat functions, he helps out a lot in my daily life, such as pouring water, lifting heavy things, and so on.
Glaucus and I agreed that we'd conduct our automation engineering experiment at about this time. Doctor, if you're interested, want to come take a look?

These water cannons were originally made for industrial usage. In addition to shooting pressurized water, they can also release high-temperature steam. So please don't touch them haphazardly; they're not like Closure's little buggies.

These high-level combat data materials are based upon my own summaries of the combat situation. Please read them carefully for the sake of future battles. After that, there are a few operation-related experiments I'd like to improve, and your help would be very valuable. I trust that you won't turn me down, will you, Doctor?

I occasionally go to Perfumer's Convalescent Garden to relax. The aroma there can wash all your stress away, truly a wonderful place for relieving the fatigue from research. Doctor, how about we head there together and give it a try next time?
I definitely do not talk to my Bionic Seadragons when I'm alone! I only gave him a name to help distinguish him more easily!
Thanks to your care and support, I've recently become more accustomed to having you around, Doctor. And apart from Glaucus and some other research colleagues, I can't say that about many people.
Peace and quiet is best.

Hello, I'm Weedy from Rhodes Island's Engineering Department. I heard your name a long time ago, so I hope we'll have a productive relationship from now on. Ah, if you want to shake hands, please take my gloved right hand.
Hmm, I didn't expect these to be this helpful.
After my promotion, can I get another upgrade to my personal room?
Thank you for acknowledging someone as frail as I am, Doctor. I'll continue to work hard for the sake of Rhodes Island.
I can join too?
Everyone, follow my instructions!
Moving out!
Everything is as we planned. To battle!
I'm right here.
My equipment is ready.
Leave it to me.
Leaf, let's do our best.
Firing!
Target locked! Engage!
Clear the way!
Haah!
As long as we employ the proper tactics, everything's a piece of cake.
Engineering cannot be underestimated.
I will adjust the parameters of this device once we head back. This won't happen again.
Leaf, cover our retreat!
Has this place been cleaned before?
H-hey!
Doctor, is there anything I can help you with?
Arknights.

Doctor, stand still and don't move a muscle, let me inspect you. Hmm… no dust on the bottom of your clothes, and your shoes are clean. That's good. Oh, wait! Your shirt collar is so wrinkled. You are not going to attend the party like that, right? Go back and sort that out, I'll wait here for you.
How do you do, Doctor.

Doctor, have you seen Leaf? His signal suddenly dropped, and my terminal indicates he's somewhere around your office… You thought he was a present and tucked him away!? The present wasn't him, it was the box on his back! Also! How were you so sure I'd give you a present!?

I work as an undurable scientist yet want to step onto the battlefield, but Rhodes Island has actually satisfied my headstrong requests. Whether in the lab or the field, I'm always asking myself: Isn't there more I can do? I'm very greedy after all, when it comes to the pursuit of scientific value.
